newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P assigns BBB-plus to Dao Heng Bnk.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns BBB-plus to Dao Heng Bnk.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had assigned BBB-plus long-term and A-2 short-term counterparty ratings to Dao Heng Bank Ltd.
The rating agency said in a statement the rating outlook for the bank was positive.

The rating reflected the bank's solid financial profile and good operating history, the above-average risk of the Hong Kong banking environment and the bank's small market position relative to Hong Kong's two dominant banking groups -- The Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corp and the Bank of China group, it said.

Dao Heng had been successful in expanding its revenue base and creating a stronger market position over the past few years and the benefits of this were recognised in the positive outlook for the bank.

But a number of issues continued to be challenges for the bank, including rapid loan growth, lack of geographic diversity and a short-term liability structure with limited long-term funding alternatives, S&P said.

The positive outlook reflects S&P's expectation that Dao Heng's credit profile gradually would improve, given the bank's conservative financial position, management's track record and increasing diversification of the bank's revenues, the rating agency said.
